name: 2026-10-29-live
about: The live bad_deploy test of 2026-10-29: errors into ALARM at 01:56:07, 36 s after the break; it re-fired at 02:03:07, after the clear, which is in the alarm history only. The live run read 10-second periods as they happened; its transcript (local) has those tables.
account: 123456789012 stands in for the account ID wherever AWS wrote it.

logs.note: Lines without their EMF _aws block, as the log tool shows them.

metrics.note: CloudWatch keeps 10-second data for 3 hours, so only 60-second periods remain.

message.S: Sample a quarter of debug logs
Revert the checkout DB pool size
Size the checkout DB pool to the new replica's connection limit
Keep abandoned carts for two days
Cache product lookups for a minute
One structured log line per request
Read pool settings from the environment
Raise the payments-api client timeout to 2 s

alarms.AlarmDescription: Over 5% of checkout-api requests fail with a 500
checkout-api p99 latency is over 1.5 s
checkout-api p99 wait for a database connection is over 100 ms
